payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods and resources used to build gazetteer resources from Wikipedia and Wikidata, detailing the processes and models involved.

claims.text: Gazetteers can be built from Wikipedia by extracting relationships and using classical machine learning models, although the data is smaller and noisier compared to Wikidata.
Wikidata is preferred for building gazetteers due to its larger dataset of around 45 million entities and its structured organization of entities and properties.
Recent methods for building gazetteer resources include using self-attention and match span encoding to enhance gazetteer embeddings from knowledge bases like Wikidata.
